scoring_justification: Result-level comparison against paper-reported gold; recomputing from raw DFT outputs is infeasible in the verifier sandbox.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for BPVB band gap, effective couplings, and maximum mobilities
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper section 3.6 (band gap 2.28 eV), Table 4 (effective couplings for P/T1/T2 dimers of BPVB), section 3.4 (maximum mobilities 0.0889 cm²/Vs for holes and 0.0152 cm²/Vs for electrons).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct transcription from the paper; cross-checked against the reference solve.sh that writes these exact numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported values for the same system, same units, and same conditions, traceable to published tables and text.

outputs.description: Electronic band gap Eg (VBM − CBM) of the BPVB crystal. Compare to paper gold with tolerance; lower is better.
Effective hole and electron transfer integrals for P, T1, T2 dimers. Compare each component to paper gold within tolerance.
Maximum anisotropic hole and electron mobilities. Compare to paper gold with relative tolerance; meeting or exceeding the reference earns full credit.

output_contract.notes: Only the BPVB crystal is reproduced. Absorption spectra (TDDFT) and Hirshfeld surface analysis are omitted as per the scoped taskability scope. All outputs are compared to the hidden paper-reported values with appropriate tolerances.

steps.description: Band gap of BPVB. Lower is better (gap ≤ target + tolerance earns full credit).
Effective transfer integrals for each channel. Each component compared to gold with tolerance (±3 meV).
Maximum hole and electron mobilities. Full credit when each computed mobility is within tolerance of the paper value.
